_comment: Golden SSD-MobileNetV2 detections for assets/datasets-test/coco, in original-frame pixels
(x1, y1, x2, y2). class_id follows the MS-COCO 90-index map this model emits (1 = person).
Produced by the bit-exact host SSD decode (== TensorFlow ssd_mobilenet_v2_coco_2018_03_29)
at score_threshold 0.30 / nms_iou 0.60; only detections scoring >= 0.95 are asserted so the
int8 on-device pipeline stays well inside the match tolerances below.
The forbidden rule covers COCO image 210273's iscrowd car region: the app should retain the
individual cars but must not present that aggregate annotation as one road-sized car.
